title: ロボティクスキャリアデザイン
subtitle: Career Design in Robotics
teachers:
SUZUKI Ryoichi
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
In this course, students will deepen their understanding of the field of robotics, which uses various cross-disciplinary technologies to solve various problems in society. Furthermore students will think about the area of learning in the department of robotics and the future image of yourself.
In addition, students will work on collecting technical information and improving writing skills in technical reports.
advice:
In this lecture,
・Exercise on improving skills related to learning in the department of robotics.
・Introducing the research topics of each faculty member in the department, and learn the technology and the required knowledge.
・Furthermore, as an opportunity to think about your own career design for the future, a lecture by an external lecturer will be held.
requiredKnowledge: This course is a basic course for students to understand the field of robotics, which integrates various cross-disciplinary technologies to solve problems. Students are required to be interested in various social issues and new technologies that are emerging every day, to think for themselves, and to actively work on them. It is important to use the contents of the lectures as an opportunity to continue independent learning and deepen learning in the future department.

activityGoals.body: Understand the research fields of the robotics, and be able to formulate your own study plan.
Explain your future career development process in your own words.

achievementLevels.ideal: Understand the technologies and issues to be addressed in the field of robotics, and be able to clarify one's own future image as an engineer who plays an active role in society, and work on learning with goals.
achievementLevels.standard: Understand the technologies and issues to be addressed in the field of robotics. Understand the abilities required as an engineer who plays an active role in society, and be able to work on learning with enthusiasm.
